title: Filter by Star Rating
content:
## Filter by Star Rating


Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000056774


## Overview


The Filter by Search Results add-on will allow the website visitors to perform a search of the members who have only a specific overall star rating.

When a visitor performs a member search on the website, they can use this additional filter to only display members with an overall rating of, for example, 4 or more stars.

```
How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Filter By Star Rating Add-On
```


## Enabling the Add-On


In Settings - Design Settings, click on General and expand " Search Results Pages":

Enable the Display Star Rating Filter option:


## Star Rating Filter


In the search results, there’s a dropdown filter that lets users select a star rating to filter members based on their reviews rating:


### Star Filter Text Labels


The text for the filter can be edited through text labels:

- Star Rating

- (Best)

- Star Rating (Best)

- Star Rating (Worst)
